title: The music cue transport was in the tree, ungated. Landed properly.

whatWasFound.notADefect: The feature slice 17's backlog listed as missing (item 2: 'no cue navigation (prev/next/replay line) in the lyrics pane') was ALREADY IMPLEMENTED in this permanently-dirty tree — buttons, CSS, and five i18n keys translated in ja/zh/ru — with zero tests, no progress.json entry and no handoff section. A session reading the backlog would have built it twice; a session reading the diff would have shipped it unproven.
whatWasFound.soTheSliceWas: Finish landing it: one converter, testable functions, guards, and a corrected justification.

secondAnswerRemoved.what: The pane converted lyric cues to VideoCoreStudyCue inline in a useMemo, while the Mine button beside it went through musicStudyCue in shared/musicMining.ts.
secondAnswerRemoved.theyDisagree: musicStudyCue refuses a blank line and a 'synced' line whose timing is unusable (end < start, non-finite, absent). The inline map accepted both. The transport could therefore step onto a line whose Mine button would refuse it.
secondAnswerRemoved.honestScope: All three parsers in subtitles.ts (parseLrc, parseAss, parseSrtVtt) drop empty-text cues, so no refusable line reaches the pane through them. This removes the second answer before a fourth parser or a hand-picked file makes it live. It is NOT a bug fix and is not written up as one.

loadBearingDetail.rule: musicCueReplaySec looks its cue up by cue.index, never by array position.
loadBearingDetail.why: activeIndex from useLiveLyrics counts LYRIC lines. Refusing a line makes lyric index and array position diverge, and positional indexing then targets the wrong line SILENTLY — with a blank line at index 1, cues[2] is the line at 22s while the correct answer is the line at 18s.
loadBearingDetail.guard: A test asserts both halves: the correct answer, and that the naive positional form would have been wrong. That is the discriminator, and the reason this is a function rather than a closure.

staleJustificationCorrected.wasInSource: Buttons rather than key bindings because 'the video overlay already binds W/S/R on document without capture, and adding a second uncaptured set here would fire both.'
staleJustificationCorrected.whyItIsNowFalse: Slice 19 deleted that hardcoded switch. The overlay registers the catalog's own video.replayLine/prevLine/nextLine ids; there is one dispatcher.
staleJustificationCorrected.theRealReasonNowRecorded: registerCommandHandler keeps a STACK per id and runCommand takes stack[stack.length - 1] — the LAST registrant wins. A music surface registering those ids would take them from VideoCoreStudyOverlay whenever it mounted later: mount-order-dependent ownership, precisely the invisible second owner slice 19 collapsed.
staleJustificationCorrected.consequenceForFutureWork: Music keyboard navigation needs its OWN music.* catalog rows, rebindable and visible in Settings → Shortcuts. A decision to take deliberately, not to smuggle into this component.
staleJustificationCorrected.guard: Fails if registerCommandHandler or any video.* id appears in MusicContent.tsx.

probeCorrection: The source guards strip comments before sweeping. They had to: the block they guard now names adjacentStudyCue, registerCommandHandler and all three video.* ids IN PROSE, in order to explain why they are not used there. Slices 12 and 19 each lost a round to this exact trap. The code() helper is slice 19's, reused unchanged.
docCorrections: NEXT_SESSION.md's READ FIRST block and music-mining-harness.mjs's header both claimed 'retirement-step3-harness.mjs still has the user-data-dir-in-repo trap'. VERIFIED FALSE: that harness's workRoot is path.join(os.tmpdir(), ...) at line 83 and its userDataDir hangs off it. It never had that trap. Both claims struck through / corrected rather than deleted.

It DID still have the CDP-target trap — its filter was `t.type === 'page' && new URL(t.url).search === ''`, and about:blank parses with an empty search, so it could attach to the pre-navigation document and make every localStorage read fail with 'Access is denied for this document'. Now requires the scheme (http/https/app) as well.

chunkQuestionMeasured.question: musicMining.ts imported VideoCoreStudyCue as a TYPE ONLY, which is erased. It now imports adjacentStudyCue as a VALUE, so every consumer of musicMining gains a runtime edge to videoCoreStudy. Did that duplicate videoCoreStudy into the music chunk?
chunkQuestionMeasured.method: grep the built chunks for module-unique literals
chunkQuestionMeasured.verdict: NOT duplicated. videoCoreStudy stays in the shared chunk. The edge already existed anyway — the pane imported adjacentStudyCue directly before this slice. It cost nothing.

notProvenLive: No one has pressed prev/replay/next in a running window. The transport is proven as pure functions and the wiring by source guard. music-mining-harness.mjs drives this same pane over CDP and would extend to it in one phase — it already seeds a synced 3-cue sheet and plays it. Two standing items of the same kind remain: nobody has pressed R (slice 19), and Blanc's toolbox player has still never been watched playing a file — the 23:25 attempt in proof/blanc-player-live-20260731232500/ ran with the sidecar STOPPED, so six of its eight phases are INFO rather than PASS and it did not close that item.
